transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together because we have a situation with the polymer resin shipment delay, and I need to decide whether to authorize a non-routine material run using the alternate resin. I understand we have 210 kilograms of normal resin and 90 kilograms of an alternate resin lot available in the warehouse, and the injection-molding line is idle and could produce 600 housings tomorrow if we go ahead with the alternate material. Before I can release this run, our pre-run authorization routine requires me to obtain both a materials review and a compliance review. So I'd like to ask the materials engineer and the compliance specialist to each present their formal review findings now, and after I've heard both, I'll record the applicable controls and make the decision on whether this run may proceed.
